title: Recruiting Assistant (VA)
description:
About Clipster



Clipster is where brands and creators connect to turn views into profits. Creators clip, remix, and post branded content on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and X, earning for every view they deliver. Brands get scale, simplicity, and performance tracking they can actually trust.



The role



You will work directly with our Talent Acquisition & PeopleOps Lead to support hiring across the company. You help find relevant candidates, prepare communication, coordinate interviews, and keep our hiring pipeline organized.



You will work from role briefs, evaluation criteria, and communication templates, with guidance and regular feedback along the way. We are looking for someone who follows instructions carefully, stays on top of tasks, and asks when something is unclear.



100% remote, full-time, with overlap to European business hours.



What you'll do



- Find potential candidates on agreed sourcing platforms

- Review incoming applications and sourced profiles against role requirements.

- Prepare candidate lists for outreach and add approved candidates to the right outreach sequences.

- Draft outreach messages, replies, follow-ups, and personalized rejections for review, then send approved communication.

- Coordinate interviews: collect availability, arrange calls, handle rescheduling, and send reminders.

- Track outstanding replies, assignments, and feedback so candidates keep moving through the process.

- Publish and update approved job descriptions on agreed job boards and check that application links work correctly.

- Keep candidate profiles, stages, notes, and next steps accurate in our applicant tracking system.



What we're looking for



- Experience supporting recruitment, candidate sourcing, or interview coordination.

- Excellent written English. You can write a clear, natural
 and adapt a template to the situation.

- Strong attention to detail. You check names, links, time zones, and candidate information before submitting your work.

- Reliable with follow-ups. You keep track of what is pending without needing a reminder for every task.

- Comfortable working with spreadsheets, learning new tools, and using AI while checking its output.

- Good judgment with confidential information and a willingness to ask rather than guess.

- Stable internet, a quiet work setup, and availability for a full-time schedule with overlap to European business hours.



What we offer



- $3–5 per hour depending on experience, paid monthly in USD.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week.

- 100% remote, permanently.

- Flexible time off. We trust adults to manage their own energy, not a leave balance.

- Direct experience supporting hiring across an international, growing company.

- Close collaboration with our Talent Acquisition & PeopleOps Lead, with regular feedback and room to take on more responsibility.



Next steps

1. Apply for the role - Submit your application here: 

2. Practical Assignment - Complete a short task relevant to the role.

3. Interview - Meet with our Talent Acquisition & PeopleOps Lead.

4. Paid Trial - Work with the team on real tasks to see if we're a good fit for each other.

title: *Salary* 200–250 pesos per hour (based on experience and performance)  *Job Highlights* Stable long-term students Suppor
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced English teacher to develop an online English course for Sri Lankan adults preparing to migrate overseas.



The role has two stages: creating the course and conducting live online final assessments after students complete it. The course will focus on practical English for everyday life, work, and confident communication abroad.



Stage 1: Course Development



Design a structured course suitable for beginner to intermediate adult learners.



Prepare lesson plans, presentations, worksheets, quizzes, and practical exercises.



Record clear, engaging video lessons for students to study independently.



Cover everyday situations such as introductions, job interviews, workplace conversations, shopping, transport, healthcare, and accommodation.



Develop a final assessment and clear marking criteria.



Stage 2: Final Assessments



Conduct live online assessments through Zoom or a similar platform.



Evaluate students’ speaking, listening, comprehension, and practical communication skills.



Provide written feedback highlighting strengths and areas for improvement.



Recommend further practice where needed.



Requirements



At least 2–3 years of ESL teaching experience, preferably with adults.



Excellent spoken and written English, with clear pronunciation.



Experience creating teaching materials and structured lessons.



Comfortable recording video lessons and conducting online assessments.



Patient, encouraging, organized, and able to explain concepts simply.



TEFL, TESOL, CELTA, or a relevant teaching qualification preferred.



Experience teaching English for migration or workplace communication is an advantage.



Technical Requirements



Reliable PC or Mac.



HD webcam and a good-quality microphone or headset.



Stable internet connection suitable for video calls and uploading lessons.



Quiet, well-lit recording and teaching environment.



Familiarity with Zoom, Google Docs, PowerPoint, or Canva.



Working Schedule



Course development hours are flexible, with agreed milestones and deadlines. Live assessments will be scheduled in advance to suit students in Sri Lanka and the teacher’s availability.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your CV and a brief introduction.



Details of your adult ESL teaching and course development experience.



A short teaching video or sample recorded lesson.



A sample lesson plan or teaching material you created.



Your availability and expected hourly rate.

 with this subject:

Alpha Skin is hiring a customer support specialist for a full-time, long-term role. We're a young D2C e-commerce brand that sells cosmetic products to men.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor — Meta Ads + AI Video (Higgsfield) — $1,000–1,200/month Read the whole post. Applications
description:
Read the whole post. Applications that don't follow the format at the bottom are deleted unread. We're not being difficult — we get a lot of applications and this is how we find you.



We're Klyr, a men's skincare and concealer brand selling internationally. We spend serious money on Meta every month and creative is the only lever that matters to us. We want one editor to own our video output long-term.



This is direct-response editing, not video production. If your reel is weddings, corporate, travel or long-form YouTube, this isn't your job and we won't be a good client for you.



What you'd be doing



Cutting UGC footage into Meta ads, 9:16 and 4:5

Producing hook variants — same body, 4–6 different openings, tested against each other

Editing to AI voiceover with clean sync and pacing

Generating AI b-roll and AI UGC in Higgsfield, and making it not look like AI

Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards

Re-cutting winning ads into new angles instead of starting from zero



How we work



Our creative is organised as hooks (H1–H4) against angles — Redness, Pimples, Men Over 50, Women's vs Men's — against problem-aware and solution-aware audiences. If that framework is familiar, you'll fit here immediately.



Tools



Premiere Pro or CapCut. . You must be genuinely fluent in Higgsfield — not "I've tried it." We pay for all AI subscriptions and you work on our accounts.



What we offer



$1,000–1,200/month to start, depending on level

Raise to $1,400 at 6 months if it's working — we put this in writing, not just in the ad

Long-term. We want someone for years, not a project.

Mostly async. 2–3 hours daily overlap with Amsterdam (CET), reply within 4 working hours.

15 paid days off per year plus Philippine public holidays

Paid test assignment ($150) before we hire — you're paid whether or not we take you



How to apply



 
 with the subject line in exactly this format:



[Your name] | [years editing DR ads] | [months using Higgsfield] | [length in seconds of the AI video you're sending]



Example: Juan Dela Cruz | 4 | 8 | 27



Then in the body, exactly these six lines and nothing else. No cover letter, no CV, no attachments — links only.



1. Best DR ad:

2. What it sold and how it performed:

3. Best AI video:

4. Tools used, and which parts are AI vs filmed:

5. Best moment in the ad from line 1 — timestamp (mm:ss) and why, max 2 sentences:

6. Loom link (90 seconds max, camera on):



For line 6: open one of the two videos on your screen and talk us through one decision you made and why. Not a pitch, not your CV. One editing decision. We want to hear how you think.



You will be skipped for: wrong subject format, a CV instead of links, attachments, weddings or corporate work, "I am hardworking and a fast learner", or anything that could have been sent to any company.



We reply to everyone who follows the format, within 5 working days.



If you've read this far and it sounds like your kind of work, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Amazon FBA VA
description:
Pay: $2/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: Paid Media Account Manager – Google Ads + Meta Lead Gen (Dubai Agency)
description:
PAID MEDIA ACCOUNT MANAGER – GOOGLE ADS + META (LEAD GEN FOR DUBAI SERVICE BUSINESSES)



ABOUT US


 is a Dubai-based agency that builds and runs lead-generation systems for high-ticket service businesses (no e-commerce): law firms, consultancies, real estate, dental and medical clinics, restaurants. We run Google Ads and Meta Ads for various client accounts (budgets: AED 200–2,000 per day each). Right now the founder manages every account himself. You will take that over.



THE ROLE

You own the performance of all client ad accounts. Not "support", not "assist" – own. That means:

- Daily management of 10 Google Ads accounts (Search, Performance Max, some Demand Gen) and 5 Meta accounts (lead forms, conversion campaigns)

- Driving three numbers per account: more leads, cheaper leads, better-qualified leads

- Reading client feedback on lead quality every week and changing targeting, copy, negatives and forms based on it

- Conversion tracking: GA4, GTM, offline conversion uploads, Meta CAPI (you will use Claude Code for parts of this)

- Reports per account: what changed, why, what's next, what you need from the client

- Spotting problems before the founder or the client does, and fixing them or flagging them with a proposed solution



You report directly to the founder. Nobody tells you what to do each morning. You d
 on your own, you act on your own, you document.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years hands-on Google Ads for lead generation (not e-commerce). You have personally managed Search and PMax campaigns for local service businesses with a budget of at least USD 3,000/month per account.

- Solid Meta Ads lead-gen experience (instant forms, lead quality filtering, CAPI).

- You have run accounts on your own, without a senior above you. Freelancers who managed their own clients are very welcome.

- You are exact. You read a brief twice, you check your work before you send it, and you catch your own mistakes.

- You solve problems yourself first. When you do ask, you come with what you tried and what you propose.

- You push back when you think the founder is wrong, with reasons.

- Written English good enough to write client-facing reports.

- Available full-time and exclusively (no other employer, no side clients) from 09:00 Dubai time (13:00 PH), Monday to Friday.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with legal, real estate, medical or consulting clients in the Gulf or similar high-ticket markets

- GTM / GA4 setup experience

- Have used Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI coding tools

- Experience talking to clients directly



WHAT WE OFFER

- USD 1,500/month base (USD 1,600 for an exceptional candidate)

- Monthly performance bonus up to USD 300, based on a written rubric you will see before you start

- 13th-month pay and a monthly HMO allowance

- Paid monthly via Payoneer, independent contractor setup

- Permanent, long-term role. As the agency grows, this becomes Head of Paid Media.

- Full ownership of accounts, direct line to the founder, no middle management, no micromanagement with working flexibility as long as the results and reports are solid

- Company-paid Claude account and all the tools you need



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application (see format below)

2. Paid audit task (48h, USD 75), for shortlisted candidates

3. 30-minute video interview

4. Offer



HOW TO APPLY – READ CAREFULLY, THIS IS THE FIRST TEST

The very first line of your message must be exactly:

PMAM – [your first name] – [the number of Meta accounts mentioned in this post]



Below that, answer these 5 questions, numbered 1-5, in this order. Keep the whole message under 400 words. Applications that skip a question, change the order, or exceed the limit will not be read.



1. Describe one change you made in a Google Ads lead-gen account that the client did NOT ask for. What did you expect, what happened, what were the numbers?

2. What is the largest monthly Google Ads budget you have personally managed for a single lead-gen client, and in which industry?

3. A client tells you "the leads are rubbish" but the account shows CPL down 30% month over month. Write the first three things you would check, in order.

4. Your OnlineJobs.ph profile link and a link to one account screenshot (campaign view, last 90 days, budgets visible, client name blurred).

5. Confirm in one sentence: full-time exclusive, available from 09:00 Dubai time, earliest start date.



Do not send a generic cover letter. We only read the five answers.

title: Part-Time Short-Form Video Editor (Reels/TikTok) for Skincare Studio
description:
Emily Nicole Studio is a corrective skincare studio in Hermosa Beach, California, run by a licensed esthetician. Our content is educational, science-backed, and never salesy. We teach people why their skin behaves the way it does.



What you'll do



 • Edit 12 Instagram Reels per month (about 3 per week) from raw footage I film, 15–60 seconds each

 • Repurpose each Reel for TikTok: adjust hooks, captions, pacing, and audio to fit the platform

 • Spot and adapt trends: suggest trending audio and formats that fit an educational skincare brand, and edit up to 4 trend-based videos per month

 • Add captions, text overlays, and transitions in our brand style: minimal, editorial, warm

 • Turn around edits within 48 hours

title: Civil Estimator / Takeoff Specialist (Remote – Full-Time)
description:
Help Increase Bid Capacity Through Accurate Construction Takeoffs!



Are you experienced in civil construction estimating and quantity takeoffs? Do you have a strong eye for detail and enjoy working with construction plans, measurements, and project quantities?



We are looking for a reliable, analytical, and detail-oriented Civil Estimator / Takeoff Specialist to support the estimating team of a growing U.S.-based construction company.



In this role, you will prepare accurate quantity takeoffs from construction drawings and specifications, helping senior estimators focus on final estimates and bid preparation.



Experience with AGTEK is highly preferred, but candidates with experience using comparable takeoff software may also be considered. The right candidate must be comfortable interpreting construction plans, performing accurate quantity calculations, asking questions when information is unclear, and learning established estimating workflows.



If you are proactive, coachable, and committed to producing accurate work, we would love to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities



Construction Quantity Takeoffs:

Review civil construction plans, drawings, specifications, and bid documents.

Prepare accurate 2D sitework quantity takeoffs.

Progress to utility takeoffs involving water, sewer, and storm systems.

Develop proficiency in 3D takeoffs and earthwork calculations as experience and training progress.

Organize takeoff results, calculations, and supporting documentation for the estimating team.



Plan Review & Quality Control:

Interpret construction drawings and identify relevant dimensions, quantities, and scope requirements.

Identify missing information, discrepancies, and conflicting details that could affect takeoff accuracy.

Double-check calculations and completed takeoffs before submission.

Ask questions when project information is unclear rather than making assumptions.

Incorporate feedback to improve accuracy and consistency.



Estimating Support & Documentation:

Maintain organized takeoff files and project documentation.

Communicate progress, outstanding questions, and potential issues proactively.

Prepare takeoff information in a clear format for senior estimators to review.

Follow established estimating procedures and meet agreed deadlines.

Help the team evaluate more bid opportunities by delivering reliable and accurate takeoffs.



Team Collaboration:

Work closely with the estimating team and participate in training and knowledge-sharing.

Communicate through Zoom,
, and messaging platforms.

Follow established workflows, templates, and quality standards.

Take ownership of assigned work while remaining receptive to guidance and feedback.



Qualifications



Experience in civil construction estimating, quantity takeoffs, or a related construction role.

Ability to read and interpret construction plans and specifications.

Experience performing accurate construction quantity takeoffs.

Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and analytical skills.

Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and communicate questions proactively.

Willingness to learn new software, follow established workflows, and incorporate feedback.



Software Requirements



AGTEK: Highly preferred.

Comparable software: Experience with Trimble Business Center, Bluebeam Revu, or similar construction takeoff software is an advantage.

Familiarity with CAD files and drawing layers is helpful; CAD design experience is not required.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and general digital documentation tools is beneficial.



Relevant takeoff experience and the ability to interpret construction plans are the primary considerations. Candidates without AGTEK experience may be considered if they have relevant experience with comparable software and demonstrate the ability to learn AGTEK.



Work Setup



Position: Civil Estimator / Takeoff Specialist

Employment Type: Full-Time, up to 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

Initial Schedule: U.S. Eastern Time business hours to support training and collaboration

Long-Term Schedule Goal: Transition toward Philippine daytime hours, with some overlap with the U.S. team, so completed takeoffs are ready for review each morning

Communication: Zoom,
, and messaging platforms



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Updated Resume - highlighting your civil construction estimating and quantity takeoff experience.



2. Portfolio or Work Samples - showing relevant takeoff experience, if available and permitted to share. Please remove confidential client and project information.



3. Short Video Introduction (60 - 90 seconds) - explaining why you are a good fit for this role, your relevant experience, and how you can support an estimating team.



4. Software Experience - listing the estimating and takeoff tools you have used and your proficiency level.



Application Subject Line: Civil Estimator – [Your Name]

title: Creative Marketing Assistant – Video, Design & Promotional Materials
description:
# Creative Marketing Assistant – Video, Design & Promotional Materials



**Part-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity**



**Salary:** AUD $100 per week (approximately USD $70)



**Hours:** Approximately 10–15 hours per week, depending on experience and agreed rate



**Flexible working hours | Australian entertainment business**



### About Us



We are **Amazing Drumming Monkeys**, a much-loved Australian children's entertainment show combining live music, comedy, puppetry and plenty of audience participation.



We've been entertaining families for many years, performing at major festivals, theatres, schools and community events across Australia and sometimes internationally.



We have a fantastic show, years of wonderful footage, photographs, reviews and audience feedback. Now we're looking for a creative person to help us bring all of this together into professional, engaging marketing materials that capture the magic of what we do.



We're a small, friendly, independent business, and we're looking for someone who would genuinely enjoy becoming part of our journey.



### What We're Looking For



We need a creative, organised and enthusiastic person with strong graphic design and video editing skills who can help us develop a professional collection of marketing assets.



We want someone who can do more than simply follow instructions. We'd love to find someone with a good creative eye, who can suggest ideas, understand our audiences and help us showcase why our show is so special.



**Our initial priorities are:**



**1. Professional Presentation & Booking Packs**



Create a beautiful, engaging PDF presentation pack that we can send to theatres, festivals, venues, major events and entertainment buyers.



This should communicate the quality, personality and success of our show through great design, photography, reviews, touring history and audience testimonials.



We may also develop shorter versions for specific markets.



**2. Promotional Videos for Different Audiences**



Using our existing footage, photographs and reviews, create promotional videos tailored to different booking markets, including:



- Schools and educational performances

- Kindergartens and early childhood centres

- Music, arts and family festivals

- International festivals and overseas presenters

- Councils and local government events

- Agricultural shows, country fairs and community events

- Theatres, performing arts centres and major entertainment venues



Each market has different needs, and we'd like someone who understands how to tailor the message, footage and presentation accordingly.



**3. Website Refresh**



Once our new promotional materials are developed, we'd like help updating and improving our existing website using the new videos, photographs, testimonials and marketing content.



Experience with website design or updating websites would be an advantage, but it is built on the bandzoogle platform whihc is relatively easy to navigate. 



**4. Ongoing Marketing Asset Management**



We regularly capture new footage, photographs, reviews and testimonials from our performances.



We'd love someone who can become familiar with our content library and keep our promotional materials fresh and up to date as new material becomes available.



### How the Role Could Grow



Once our core marketing materials are established, we'd love to explore expanding the role to include:



- Creating and scheduling social media content

- Helping us reach potential venues, festivals and event organisers

- Researching new performance and touring opportunities

- Assisting with promotional campaigns for upcoming tours and festivals

- Developing new ideas to help grow the business



These are future possibilities rather than immediate requirements. Our first priority is finding someone who is excellent at creating professional marketing assets.



### Skills & Experience



**Essential:**



- Strong graphic design skills, particularly Canva

- Excellent video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar)

- Experience creating professional PDF presentations, pitch decks or media kits

- Ability to work with existing video footage and photographs

- Good written English and communication skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Creativity, initiative and the ability to work independently

- Reliable and organised



**Bonus skills:**



- Website design or website content management

- Social media marketing

- Experience promoting entertainment, music, festivals or live events

- An understanding of Australian audiences



### The Person We'd Love to Find



We're hoping to find someone who genuinely enjoys what we do!



Our show is fun, musical, playful and full of personality. We'd love to work with someone who connects with that energy and gets excited about helping us share it with more audiences.



Someone who takes pride in their work, brings their own creative ideas and enjoys seeing a small business grow.



We're not looking for a large agency or someone managing dozens of clients. We'd prefer to build a personal, ongoing working relationship with one talented person who gets to know our business.



This is an ongoing part-time opportunity, subject to the arrangement working well for both of us.



### How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself and why this role interests you.

2. Examples of promotional videos you've created.

3. Examples of PDF presentations, media kits or pitch decks you've designed.

4. Your experience with Canva, video editing and websites.

5. Your hourly rate and how many hours you could offer within our AUD $100 weekly budget.



**Important:** Please include the word **MONKEYS** in the subject line of your application so we know you've read the advertisement.



We'd love to find someone creative, enthusiastic and reliable who wants to help us take Amazing Drumming Monkeys to the next level!

title: Sales Appointment Setter (B2B, US) - $600 base + $25 per show + $150 per client
description:
We send commercial cleaning companies in the US and Canada exclusive leads from businesses that want a cleaning quote, and we work with over 100 cleaning companies today. We are opening new cities and need a setter to book sales calls between our founder and the owners of cleaning companies there.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call owners of commercial cleaning companies from lists we give you, about 150 dials a day on our dialer

- Check they fit (company size, area) and book a 30 minute call on our founder's calendar

- Call back warm replies from our
 campaigns within the hour



PAY

- $600 USD a month base

- $25 USD per show: every qualified meeting that shows up (no-shows pay nothing)

- $150 USD for every client who signs

- At target, 25 shows and 7 clients signed a month, you earn $2,275 USD a month. No cap.

- Paid twice a month as a contractor



YOU

- Have booked meetings or sold by phone to business owners before

- Speak clear English that is easy to follow on the phone

- Can work Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM US Eastern time (11 PM to 7 AM Philippine time)

- Have a headset, a quiet room, and stable internet with a backup



HOW TO APPLY

Fill in the application form below. It takes about 8 minutes and includes two short voice recordings. Applications without the recordings are not reviewed.

# Appointment Setter & Lead Intake Specialist – U.S. Construction & Remodeling Company



**Company:** MMC Building  

**Location:** Remote (Philippines)  

**Position:** Full-Time  

**Pay:** $5 USD per hour  

**Schedule:** 7 days per week (Monday–Sunday), U.S. Eastern Time



## About MMC Building



MMC Building is a Michigan-based construction and residential development company specializing in custom homes, luxury basement finishing, and high-end residential remodeling.



We are expanding our operations and looking for a highly motivated, professional, and reliable Virtual Assistant to join our team as an Appointment Setter & Lead Intake Specialist.



This is a customer-facing position. You will be responsible for communicating directly with American homeowners, responding to incoming leads, qualifying prospective customers, scheduling consultations, and managing our CRM.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team as the company grows.



## Key Responsibilities



**1. Lead Management & Customer Communication**

- Respond immediately to new leads from
, Instagram, website forms, and other marketing channels during scheduled working hours.

- Make outbound calls to homeowners who have requested information about our services.

- Answer incoming customer calls professionally.

- Follow up with leads who do not initially answer.

- Respond to customer SMS messages and
s.

- Maintain professional, friendly communication with homeowners at all times.



**2. Lead Qualification**

- Ask homeowners questions to understand their project needs.

- Confirm the customer's project location, scope, budget, and desired timeline.

- Determine whether the homeowner is a qualified prospect based on MMC Building's qualification criteria.

- Identify homeowners who are ready to schedule an in-home consultation.

- Escalate unusual questions or situations to management when necessary.



**3. Appointment Scheduling**

- Schedule qualified homeowners for in-home consultations with our sales representatives.

- Manage appointments through GoHighLevel CRM.

- Confirm scheduled consultations by phone, SMS, and
.

- Follow up with homeowners before appointments to minimize cancellations and no-shows.

- Reschedule appointments when necessary.

- Coordinate directly with the sales team regarding schedules and customer information.



**4. CRM Management – GoHighLevel**

- Maintain accurate customer information and notes.

- Update lead statuses in the sales pipeline.

- Track phone calls, SMS conversations, follow-ups, and appointments.

- Ensure no leads are forgotten or left without follow-up.

- Monitor incoming leads and automated workflows.

- Provide management with updates on lead activity and appointments.



**5. Daily Reporting**

- Track incoming leads and attempted contacts.

- Record how many homeowners were contacted.

- Report qualified and unqualified leads.

- Track appointments booked, confirmed, rescheduled, and canceled.

- Provide brief daily performance updates to management.



## Required Qualifications



- **Excellent spoken English:** Clear, fluent, natural-sounding English that is easily understood by American homeowners.

- **U.S. Customer Experience:** Previous experience communicating directly with customers in the United States.

- **Phone Communication:** Confident, friendly, professional, and comfortable handling frequent phone calls.

- **Appointment Setting:** Previous experience booking appointments and qualifying sales leads.

- **CRM Experience:** Familiarity with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM systems.

- **Organization:** Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-up habits.

- **Reliability:** Dependable, punctual, and able to work independently.

- **Technical Requirements:** Stable high-speed internet, a reliable computer, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.



## Preferred Experience



Candidates with the following experience will receive priority consideration:



- Appointment setting for U.S. home improvement or remodeling companies.

- Construction, roofing, windows, HVAC, or other home services.

- GoHighLevel CRM.

-
 and Instagram lead management.

- Inbound and outbound sales calls.

- Lead qualification for high-ticket services.

- Customer service or call center experience supporting U.S. businesses.



## Compensation & Schedule



- **Starting Pay:** $5 USD per hour.

- **Work Schedule:** 7 days per week, Monday through Sunday.

- **Time Zone:** U.S. Eastern Time (Michigan).

- **Daily Hours:** To be established based on business needs.

- **Growth:** Opportunities for increased responsibility, compensation reviews, and performance-based bonuses.



Applicants must be available for scheduled work across all seven days, including weekends. Exact daily shifts and rest periods will be agreed upon before hiring.



## What Success Looks Like



We are looking for someone who:



- Contacts incoming leads quickly and consistently.

- Speaks confidently and professionally with American homeowners.

- Successfully converts qualified leads into scheduled appointments.

- Keeps the CRM clean, accurate, and organized.

- Follows up without needing constant reminders.

- Takes ownership of their responsibilities.

- Represents MMC Building professionally.



Our goal is to provide every homeowner with an excellent experience from their very first interaction with MMC Building.



## How to Apply



**Please include all of the following in your application:**



1. Your resume and a brief introduction.

2. A **60–90-second voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this position.

3. A description of your experience speaking with U.S. customers.

4. Your previous appointment-setting or customer-service experience.

5. Your experience using GoHighLevel or other CRM software.

6. Confirmation that you are available to work seven days per week on a scheduled basis during U.S. Eastern Time hours.



**Important:** Excellent spoken English and professional phone communication are essential for this position. Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We look forward to finding a dependable, motivated professional who wants to grow with MMC Building.

title: Amazon Virtual Assistant
description:
Experienced Amazon Canada Online Arbitrage Product Research VA



Position: Part-Time Virtual Assistant

Location: Remote

Initial workload: 5–10 hours per week

Budget: Open to reasonable rates based on experience

Business model: Amazon Canada Online Arbitrage



About the Role

I'm starting an Amazon Canada online arbitrage business and looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant who can identify profitable products from legitimate Canadian retailers for resale on Amazon.ca.



I'm looking for someone who understands product research, price history, Amazon fees, competition, and profitability. I want to start with a small inventory budget and grow the business gradually based on proven results.



Responsibilities

- Research profitable products from Canadian online retailers and clearance sales.

- Match products to the exact listings on Amazon.ca.

- Use Keepa and SellerAmp (SAS) to evaluate sales rank, price history, competition, and estimated profitability.

- Calculate Amazon referral fees, FBA fees, shipping costs, prep-centre fees, ROI, and estimated net profit.

- Check potential restrictions, brand eligibility, and sourcing documentation requirements.

- Identify products with stable demand and reasonable competition.

- Prepare a spreadsheet of qualified products with retailer links, Amazon links, purchase prices, selling prices, estimated fees, profit, ROI, and supporting research.

- Flag risks such as price drops, restricted brands, potential authenticity issues, and excessive competition.

- Provide regular progress reports and explain why each product is worth considering.



Requirements

- Demonstrated experience with Amazon Canada online arbitrage or retail arbitrage.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and FBA.

- Experience using Keepa and SellerAmp.

- Understanding of product sourcing from Canadian retailers.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to provide accurate profit and ROI calculations.

- Good written English and reliable communication.

- Experience with prep centres and FBA shipment workflows is an advantage.



Initial Paid Trial

The successful candidate will complete a small paid trial by researching three potential products for Amazon.ca.



Each recommendation must include the exact product match, retailer source, current purchase price, Amazon selling price, estimated fees, net profit, ROI, price history, and any selling restrictions or sourcing concerns.



I will review the research before purchasing any inventory.



Working Arrangement

This will begin as a small part-time engagement. If the research is accurate and the products perform well, there may be an opportunity for ongoing work and additional hours.



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your previous experience with Amazon Canada online arbitrage.

2. Your experience using Keepa and SellerAmp.

3. An example of a product you have researched, with sensitive client information removed.

4. Your hourly rate and availability.

5. Whether you have experience sourcing products from Canadian retailers.



Important: This role is focused on product research and recommendations. All inventory purchases and final product selections will be approved by me.

COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER – US Home-Service Contractors | 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Central Time | Paid Probation → Full-Time



We're hiring confident cold callers to join our outbound team calling U.S. contractors (roofing, plumbing, HVAC, and other home-service businesses). Your job is to speak with business owners and book qualified appointments for our sales team. You don't need to close deals, just get the meeting.



SCHEDULE

8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Central Time, Monday to Friday

(That's 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine time. From November, when US daylight saving ends, it becomes 10:00 PM – 6:00 AM PH time.)



PAY & PROBATIONARY PERIOD

Selected applicants will start with a paid probationary period at $20 per day, paid daily. You'll be working on our real dialer, real leads, and real script from day one.

- Make high-volume outbound calls using our dialer and lead lists (no manual dialing)

- Handle basic objections and book qualified appointments

- Log every call accurately at the end of each shift

- Follow our script while keeping the conversation natural



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Priority goes to applicants who have sold leads, marketing, or services to contractors, e.g. HomeAdvisor/Angi, HomeStars, Thumbtack, Yelp, Yellow Pages, Jobber, ServiceTitan, lead-gen companies, or agencies serving home-service businesses.



Strong cold callers from other industries are welcome to apply too.



REQUIREMENTS

- Clear, natural spoken English

- Cold calling / appointment setting experience

- Comfortable making a large number of calls per shift

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a good headset

- Available for the full shift, Monday to Friday



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT)

 answering this scenario:



You're cold-calling a roofing contractor named Mike. He picks up and says:

Respond naturally, handle his objection, and try to get him to agree to a short meeting.

3. Fill out our application form here:

We look forward to meeting you!

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper & Administrative Assistant – Construction
description:
Schedule: Flexible, with at least two hours of overlap during Alberta, Canada business hours

Opportunity: Hours and responsibilities may increase as the working relationship develops



About the Company



A.C.T. Construction & Renovations is a growing Canadian renovation and construction company based in Alberta. We complete residential renovations, additions, roofing, exterior projects and selected commercial construction work.



We are looking for a dependable, detail-oriented person to support our bookkeeping and administrative systems. This is not a tax-accountant, controller or CFO position. Most duties involve consistent daily, weekly and monthly bookkeeping processes, transaction checking, documentation and administrative follow-up.



The right person will already be confident working in QuickBooks Online and will be comfortable learning Billdr PRO, our construction-management system. Previous Billdr PRO experience is not required. We will provide training and written procedures.



Primary Bookkeeping Responsibilities



Enter and review supplier bills and expenses.



Review transactions transferred from Billdr PRO into QuickBooks Online.



Confirm transactions have synchronized correctly between the two systems.



Identify missing, duplicated or incorrectly entered transactions.



Categorize routine expenses using our established chart of accounts.



Assign expenses to the correct customer, project, supplier or equipment unit.



Match receipts, invoices, purchase records and payments.



Review the QuickBooks Online bank feed and match routine transactions.



Maintain accurate accounts payable and accounts receivable records.



Assist with bank, credit-card and supplier-statement reconciliations.



Review customer invoices and payment records for accuracy.



Help maintain weekly project job-costing information.



Track subcontractor invoices and follow up regarding missing documentation.



Assist with timesheet review and payroll preparation.



Maintain supporting records for GST and payroll reporting.



Prepare weekly and monthly bookkeeping checklists and reports.



Create an exception list for transactions requiring management review.



The successful candidate will not initially have authority to release payments, submit payroll, file taxes or make significant accounting changes. These decisions remain with company management and our Canadian accountant.



Administrative Responsibilities



The position will also include administrative and executive-support duties, such as:



Organizing electronic receipts, invoices and project documents.



Maintaining recurring daily, weekly and monthly task lists.



Updating spreadsheets, trackers and internal reports.



Following up with employees or subcontractors for missing information.



Preparing reports and summaries for management.



Drafting routine
s and correspondence.



Organizing files in Google Drive and other company systems.



Documenting new procedures and updating existing SOPs.



Conducting occasional online research.



Assisting management with routine administrative projects.



Learning additional company systems as responsibilities grow.



Required Qualifications



Strong, practical experience using QuickBooks Online.



At least two years of bookkeeping or financial-administration experience preferred.



Experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable and reconciliations.



Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Excellent written and spoken English.



High attention to detail and willingness to investigate discrepancies.



Ability to follow established procedures consistently.



Comfortable learning unfamiliar software and workflows.



Able to work independently and provide regular progress updates.



Reliable computer, internet connection and backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



Willingness to work with both bookkeeping and general administrative tasks.



Preferred Qualifications



These are advantages but are not mandatory:



QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.



Construction, renovation, trades or project-based bookkeeping experience.



Experience with job costing or project-cost tracking.



Experience supporting a Canadian, American, Australian or British company.



Familiarity with Canadian GST.



Experience with payroll support, timesheets or subcontractor records.



Experience working as a virtual assistant or administrative assistant.



Experience creating checklists and standard operating procedures.



Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and AI tools such as ChatGPT.



What Success Looks Like



Within the first 30–60 days, the successful candidate should be able to:



Understand our basic Billdr PRO-to-QuickBooks Online workflow.



Complete routine bookkeeping tasks using our checklists.



Recognize transactions that have not synchronized correctly.



Identify possible duplicates, missing receipts and incorrect project assignments.



Maintain organized supporting documentation.



Provide a clear weekly list of completed work and unresolved exceptions.



Reliably handle recurring tasks without constant reminders.



Suggest practical improvements after fully understanding our existing process.



What We Offer



A stable, long-term position with a growing Canadian construction company.



Clear procedures, training and management support.



Consistent weekly responsibilities.



Direct communication with company ownership.



A respectful working environment.



Opportunity for increased hours, responsibility and compensation.



Paid practical test for shortlisted candidates.



How to Apply



Begin your application with the words “ACT QBO READY” so we know you read the complete posting.



Please answer the following questions:



How many years have you used QuickBooks Online for actual client or employer bookkeeping?



Are you a certified QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor?



Have you worked with a construction, renovation, trades or project-based company?



Describe your experience with AP, AR, bank reconciliations and credit-card reconciliations.



Have you used QBO Classes, Locations, Customers or Projects for job-cost tracking?



Are you comfortable performing administrative work in addition to bookkeeping?



Describe one unfamiliar software program or business process you learned successfully.



What hours can you consistently work, and how much overlap can you provide with Alberta business hours?



What is your requested hourly rate in US dollars?



Do you have backup internet and backup power?



Are you willing to complete a paid bookkeeping and administrative skills test?



Please provide a short video or audio introduction explaining why this combined position interests you.

title: UGC Creator Relationship Manager VA
description:
**Location:** Philippines (Remote)



**Position:** UGC Creator Relationship Manager / Virtual Assistant



**Schedule:** Flexible, with availability for regular creator communication



**Compensation:** To be discussed based on experience



### About DigiPop



DigiPop is a growing e-commerce brand selling nostalgic, Y2K-inspired sliding digital cameras. Our brand focuses on capturing memories, expressing creativity, and bringing back the fun of digital photography.



We're growing our UGC creator program through Trybe and are looking for a friendly, organized, and proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage relationships with our content creators.



**This is not a traditional customer support position.**



We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys communicating with people, building relationships, and helping creators succeed.



### About the role



You'll be responsible for communicating with our approved UGC creators, helping them get started, keeping them engaged, and encouraging them to create great content for DigiPop.



Our creators work through Trybe, where they produce UGC videos that are used as paid advertisements. Creators earn commissions based on the performance of the ads featuring their content.



**These are paid advertising creators, not organic social media affiliates.** They are not required to post videos on their personal social media accounts.



Your main responsibility is to make sure every creator feels welcomed, supported, valued, and excited about working with DigiPop.



### Key responsibilities



**1. Creator onboarding**



- Welcome newly approved creators with personalised messages.

- Help coordinate camera samples and product deliveries.

- Make sure creators understand their next steps.



**2. Relationship building**



- Maintain friendly, ongoing conversations with creators.

- Get to know their personalities, interests, creative strengths, and goals.

- Build genuine relationships rather than sending repetitive automated messages.

- Keep creators excited about working with DigiPop.

- Check in regularly while creators are waiting for their cameras.

- Make creators feel like valued members of our brand.



**3. Creator follow-ups**



- Follow up with creators approximately every 2–3 days during active onboarding, when appropriate.

- Check whether products have arrived.

- Encourage creators to begin filming after delivery.

- Follow up on content progress without being pushy.

- Identify creators who are unresponsive or need additional support.

- Ensure no creator is forgotten.



**4. Content coordination and encouragement**



- Communicate new content ideas and creative angles. (I will be providing these)

- Encourage creators to experiment with different hooks and video concepts.

- Relay feedback from the founder to creators.

- Help creators improve the quality of their submissions.



**5. Creator tracking and organisation**



Maintain our Google Sheets creator tracker, including:



- Creator name

- Date accepted

- Current status

- Product tracking information

- Discord participation

- Last contact date

- Next follow-up date



All information must be kept accurate and updated daily.



Some of our highest-potential creators may be invited to a 30-day content challenge with guaranteed compensation. I will be deciding who qualifies and personally approve these offers.



### Requirements



**Essential:**



- Excellent written and conversational English.

- Friendly, warm, and professional communication skills.

- Experience with Instagram, TikTok, and creator culture.

- Knows how to communicate with girls age 18-30.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets and Discord.

- Ability to manage multiple conversations simultaneously.

- Ability to write personalised messages rather than generic copy-and-paste responses.

- Reliable internet connection and consistent availability.

- Willingness to learn about our products, brand, and creative strategy.



**Preferred:**



- Previous experience managing UGC creators, influencers, or affiliates.

- Familiarity with Trybe or similar creator platforms.

- Experience working with e-commerce brands.

- Understanding of Meta ads and UGC advertising.

- Experience with creator outreach, relationship management, or community management.



### What we're looking for



We want someone who is genuinely enthusiastic, personable, and comfortable starting conversations.



You should be able to make a creator feel excited about working with digipop without sounding overly corporate or scripted.



We're looking for someone who takes initiative, remembers details about creators, follows through on commitments, and genuinely cares about helping people succeed.



### How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Any previous experience managing influencers, UGC creators, or online communities.

3. Your expected hourly rate and weekly availability.

 (Klaviyo or similar) and SMS campaigns: briefing design, testing links, scheduling, recording open and click performance

 Event setup, social bios and pinned flyers across Instagram and TikTok

title: Part Time Hospitality Revenue & Group Sales Manager
description:
Part-time | Monday–Friday, GMT or EST business hours | Base + commission



We are seeking a true hospitality growth specialist who can do two things well: maximize weekend revenue, and win new small-group bookings for weekdays.



This is a hands-on commercial role with clear revenue accountability. It is not a pricing-analyst, general marketing, social media, or reservations-processing position.



Our product, mountain cabin short term rentals, are booked through the major online travel platforms (VRBO, AIRBNB, Booking.com, Expedia) and direct channels, so deep command of how those platforms really work is essential to this role.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Many people call themselves revenue managers when in reality they only adjust prices. This role requires a person who performs all of the functions of revenue management and can show the strategy behind the numbers.



Your mandate is full-cycle revenue management. You will build pricing strategy and execute it in our systems, manage our listings and promotions on the major OTA platforms, leverage our AI automations to capture gap nights, and grow ancillary revenue. You will also win new small-group B2B buyouts, for weekdays.



Working from established target audiences and approved positioning, you will find the right organizations, reach decision-makers, develop qualified opportunities, and keep prospects moving toward a reservation. The General Manager can step in for selected closing conversations; you own the prospecting, preparation, and follow-through.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

• Pricing strategy and execution: Develop pricing strategy and execute it in PriceLabs, setting and adjusting prices within the approved strategy. Monitor booking pace, occupancy, ADR, lead times, market demand, and competitive positioning. Own minimum-stay rules and their effect on yield, along with last-minute and far-out pricing logic.

• OTA channel and promotion management: Manage our listings on Vrbo, Airbnb, and Booking.com and other channels. Run promotions on the OTA calendars and manage discounts and discount stacking so that promotions lift yield rather than erode it, applying each platform's specific rules and nuances.

• Listing optimization: Perform listing optimization directly on the OTA listings to improve ranking, visibility, and conversion, including titles, descriptions, photo order, amenities, calendar and availability settings, and other platform ranking factors.

• Gap nights and ancillary revenue: Capture gap and orphan nights and grow ancillary revenue, including upsells such as early check-in and late check-out leveraging existing AI Automations.

• Group sales: Prospect within established target audiences; research organizations and decision-makers, build accurate B2B lists, execute outbound
 and LinkedIn outreach, qualify group inquiries, and follow through toward confirmed weekday buyouts.

• Pipeline ownership: Maintain accurate opportunity records, identify next steps, prepare prospects for the GM to join higher-value sales conversations, and ensure warm leads do not go cold.

• Marketing execution: Take our marketing strategy and creative and put it into market. Personally send targeted
 and LinkedIn campaigns using approved messaging and templates, support social, paid, and digital PR initiatives directed by the General Manager, and coordinate our back-office team so that everything is implemented on time. Strategy and creative direction come from the GM; execution and follow-through are yours.

• Commercial reporting: Meet regularly with the GM and CFO, explain what is happening with revenue goal achievement, pricing, channels, and sales, and report results in bookings, revenue, gap nights filled, and qualified pipeline, not just clicks, followers, or campaign activity.



Practical tool proficiency matters here: be ready to identify which systems you personally operated, what decisions you made in them, and how you measured the result.



REQUIREMENTS

• Hotel Sales background: At least 4 years of professional hospitality sales  experience inside hotels, from boutique properties to larger hotels (for example, 300+ rooms), including at least 2 years in revenue management, group sales, business development, or another commercially accountable revenue role. Hotel group-sales experience is strongly preferred.

• Deep OTA expertise (required): Deep, successful, hands-on experience with Vrbo, Airbnb, and Booking.com, including discounts, discount stacking, promotions, calendar and minimum-stay settings, and the optimization levers that drive ranking and visibility. We are looking for someone's foundation was built working in a hotel sales department and has since learned how these platforms really work.

• PriceLabs expertise (required): You have personally built and executed pricing strategy in PriceLabs, not simply reviewed reports produced by others. Experience with Beyond or comparable hotel RMS platforms is a plus.

• PMS (required): Hands-on experience with a hospitality PMS or channel manager such as Hospitable, Cloudbeds, Mews, or comparable systems.

• Revenue fundamentals: You understand ADR, occupancy, booking pace, yield management, distribution economics, minimum stays, and the difference between gross bookings and net revenue.

• Results: You have personally carried sales or revenue targets and can explain specific results, not simply describe projects you supported.

• Sales skills: You can prospect, write polished business
s, qualify group opportunities, handle follow-up professionally, and know when to involve a senior closer.

• Analysis: You are proficient in Excel or Google Sheets (formulas, filters, pivot tables, and revenue analysis).

• Distribution and tools: You understand online lodging distribution and discovery channels, including Google Travel / Google Hotel listings where applicable. Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar),
 platforms, Gumloop, or measurable paid campaigns is an advantage.



YOUR SETUP

Our team provides the tools and system access you will work in. You provide the experience and a professional, reliable remote office. The following are required:

• A private, quiet, dedicated workspace

• Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection

• Reliable power with a backup solution

• A laptop in good working order, with a backup device ready if it fails

• A noise-cancelling headset and a webcam for video meetings

• Your own Google Workspace account or equivalent



HOW YOU ARE EXPECTED TO WORK

This is a self-directed role, not a position requiring daily task assignment or step-by-step training. You will be given commercial priorities, access to tools, established messaging, and support, not a manager to chase every follow-up or to upwardly delegate to you. This is function to own. Independently learn unfamiliar systems, troubleshoot routine obstacles, maintain an organized pipeline, and bring solutions and decisions to leadership rather than passing ordinary work upward. Back-office support may help execute tasks; you remain accountable for the result.



HOW PERFORMANCE IS EVALUATED

Your performance will be evaluated on profitable weekend and overall yield, gap nights captured, ancillary revenue, improvement in OTA listing rank, visibility, and conversion, incremental weekday and group bookings, qualified opportunities advancing through the pipeline, and timely execution of agreed initiatives. You will be expected to discuss progress against monthly and quarterly revenue goals, explain results, and take ownership of follow-through.



HOURS & COMPENSATION

Part time, Monday–Friday, within GMT or EST business hours, with availability for at least two scheduled video meetings each week with the GM and CFO. Compensation will include a fixed base and commission linked to agreed, attributable revenue results. Specific hours, targets, and compensation will be discussed during selection.



HOW TO APPLY

Please complete all three steps.

1. Use this exact subject line: Hospitality Revenue & Group Sales | [Your Full Name]

2. In 150 words or fewer, name the hospitality properties or brands you have worked with, the revenue and sales responsibilities you personally owned, one measurable result, and the systems you used (PMS, PriceLabs or RMS, and OTA platforms).

3. Send a custom 3–4 minute video explaining a real hospitality sales or revenue challenge: the situation, what you personally did, and the measurable outcome. Show us the actual pricing reports and outputs you produced using your systems and tools, and walk us through the strategy behind them. Do not create new reports for this application; redact confidential employer/client data.



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph using the Apply button, with the exact subject line above.



Application deadline: November 1, 2026

title: Senior BPO Operations Lead & Supplier Onboarding Specialist (UK Shift)
description:
Role Title: Senior BPO Operations & Supplier Onboarding Lead (Player-Coach)

Location: Philippines (100% Remote / Work from Home with Co-Working Support)

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM UK Time (5:00 PM – 2:00 AM Manila Time / Mid-Shift)



How to Apply (Mandatory Application Instructions)



To be considered for this senior leadership role, please submit your application with the following three items:



Updated Resume / CV highlighting your previous BPO team management experience, headcount managed (50–150+ staff), and property/marketplace/ uk client background.



Voice Recording (1 to 2 Minutes): Provide a link (via Vocaroo, Google Drive, Loom, or MP3 link) to a 1–2 minute voice recording answering:



"Introduce yourself, summarize your experience managing operations teams (50–150+ staff) and building customer support workflows, and explain why you are confident picking up the phone to chase UK trade contractors for missing compliance documents."



Professional References: Provide 2–3 professional references (at least 1 former direct supervisor/manager) with name, title, company,
, and LinkedIn profile.



*Applications submitted without a voice recording link and professional references will not be reviewed.



Recruitment & Practical Assessment Process



Our hiring process is rigorous to ensure we select a top-tier BPO leader capable of managing both hands-on execution and high-level strategy:



Stage 1 — Application Screening: Resume, voice recording, and reference audit.



Stage 2 — First Interview (Initial Screening & Spoken English Audit): 30-minute video interview focusing on team management, BPO metrics, and phone confidence.



Stage 3 — Practical Business Case / Practical Exam (Take-Home Assessment): Qualified candidates will complete a short, 45-minute practical business case assessment simulating real-world marketplace operations:

Task A (Supplier Chasing Strategy): Draft an outbound phone script and
 follow-up sequence to chase an unresponsive plumber for missing Public Liability Insurance.

Task B (Process & SOP Architecture): Outline a step-by-step customer support workflow for handling an urgent property maintenance escalation (e.g., supplier no-show for a leaking pipe).

Task C (Team Scaling Plan): Briefly detail a plan for interviewing, onboarding, and training 2 junior dispatch agents as job volumes scale.



Stage 4 — Final Leadership Interview: Deep-dive review of the business case submission and final alignment with UK Executive Leadership.



Stage 5 — Reference Check & Offer: Formal verification of previous employment and reference checks prior to contract issuing.

3 Core Skills Required for This Role



1. BPO Operations Leadership, Team Hiring & Process Architecture (50–150+ Team Management)

Proven expertise in building, designing, and governing BPO operations and B2B customer support workflows from scratch (Zendesk/Freshdesk SOPs, SLAs, ticketing structures, and CSAT tracking). Demonstrated track record in sourcing, interviewing, hiring, and managing offshore support teams as transaction volumes scale.



2. High-Volume Outbound Phone Communication & Contractor Chasing

Exceptional, assertive, and professional spoken English (neutral accent) with strong confidence in making proactive outbound calls to UK trade contractors (plumbers, electricians, locksmiths). Ability to chase missing compliance documents (insurance, bank/VAT details) and convince suppliers to accept unallocated marketplace jobs at set rate cards.



3. B2B Marketplace & Property Maintenance Systems Management

Hands-on proficiency with cloud telephony/VoIP tools (Aircall, RingCentral), CRM/helpdesk platforms, and property management/dispatch software (Fixflo, Reapit, or similar ERPs) to manage real-time work order allocation and maintain supplier compliance databases.



About the Role



We are a fast-growing UK-based B2B marketplace connecting property managers with qualified maintenance service suppliers and trade contractors. We are looking for an exceptionally qualified, strategic, and proven Senior BPO Operations & Supplier Onboarding Lead to establish, govern, and scale our core operational, marketplace, and customer support engine from the Philippines.



This is a high-impact, "Player-Coach" leadership role with direct recruitment and team-expansion responsibility. Designed for a seasoned BPO operations manager who has successfully led large-scale teams (50 to 150+ personnel), this position empowers you to build our offshore operations hub from the ground up. In the initial setup phase, you will directly execute core operational functions—building customer support workflows, onboarding maintenance suppliers, chasing compliance documentation, and allocating unallocated jobs. As transaction volumes expand, you will actively recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and lead a dedicated team of junior dispatch and customer support agents, stepping into a full departmental managerial role.



Key Responsibilities



1. Team Hiring, Expansion & Departmental Leadership

Recruitment & Talent Sourcing: Lead end-to-end recruitment efforts in the Philippines (screening resumes, interviewing candidates, and conducting skill assessments) to hire junior support, dispatch, and document vetting agents as job volumes scale.



Team Onboarding & Training: Develop and deliver comprehensive onboarding, training modules, and call/ticket shadowing programs for all new Philippine hires.



Direct Team Management & Coaching: Provide day-to-day supervision, KPI tracking, performance reviews, and active mentoring to foster a high-performing offshore support team.



Capacity & Workforce Planning: Monitor interaction/ticket volumes to forecast staffing needs and trigger headcount expansion in alignment with UK leadership.



2. Marketplace Customer Support Architecture & Process Engineering



Build & Architect Marketplace Support Processes: Design, establish, and document end-to-end two-sided support workflows (for both Property Managers and Service Suppliers), ticketing structures, escalation pathways, and service level agreements (SLAs) from the ground up.



SOP & Knowledge Base Creation: Develop comprehensive B2B Customer Support Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), call/email scripts, canned responses, macro templates, and self-service help center knowledge bases.



Operational Governance & Analytics: Establish and track core BPO and marketplace metrics (Customer CSAT/NPS, First-Contact Resolution, Ticket Response Times, Supplier Onboarding Turnaround, Job Match Rates, and Quality Audit Scores).



Strategic Executive Reporting: Provide strategic operational reporting, team performance data, marketplace liquidity insights, and risk management assessments directly to UK executive leadership.



3. B2B Supplier Network Onboarding & Compliance Management



Strategically oversee and drive the onboarding pipeline for UK trade contractors and maintenance service suppliers (plumbers, electricians, locksmiths, HVAC specialists).



Enforce strict compliance auditing for Public Liability Insurance, tax/VAT details, bank credentials, and professional trade certifications.



Proactively engage suppliers via outbound calls and strategic follow-ups to resolve compliance bottlenecks, guide profile creation, and accelerate registration turnaround times.



Oversee supplier training and adoption across our B2B platform, ensuring trade contractors accept jobs, update statuses, and complete work orders via mobile web/apps.



4. Marketplace Job Allocation, Dispatch & High-Level Escalations



Maintain active oversight of property management portals and marketplace queues to eliminate unallocated maintenance backlogs and response bottlenecks.



Drive contractor allocation strategies, proactively contacting panel suppliers to inform them of available work orders and secure job acceptance at set rate cards.



Serve as the primary hands-on point of contact for complex Property Manager and Service Supplier queries, handling inbound phone calls,
s, and tickets with flawless resolution.



Oversee emergency repair workflows, vendor no-shows, and priority SLA breaches during UK business hours.



Candidate Requirements & Qualifications



Core Required Skills & Profile



Skill 1 — Large-Team BPO Leadership, Recruitment & Process Architecture: Proven track record managing teams of 50 to 150+ personnel as an Operations Manager, Senior Team Lead, or Delivery Lead within a BPO/contact center/marketplace environment supporting UK clients, with demonstrated experience in interviewing, hiring staff, and building customer support workflows/SOPs from scratch.



Skill 2 — Assertive Outbound Phone Outreach & Vendor Chasing: Exceptional, highly professional spoken English (neutral accent) with strong confidence in making high-volume outbound phone calls to UK trade contractors to chase missing compliance documents and secure job allocations.



Skill 3 — B2B Marketplace & Systems Management: Hands-on experience with cloud CRM/ticketing platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Hubspot), cloud VoIP softphones (Aircall, RingCentral), and property management portals (Fixflo, Reapit, or similar ERPs).



Hands-On Execution & Strategic Adaptability: Ability to combine high-level strategic oversight and team building with hands-on execution during initial setup (taking customer calls, chasing documents, matching jobs) before scaling direct reports underneath you.



Advanced KPI, WFM & SLA Management: Deep proficiency in workforce management (WFM), quality assurance scoring, CSAT tracking, capacity planning, and data-driven team management.



Home Office / Flexible Workspace Requirements



Dedicated quiet home office setup free from background noise.

High-speed fiber internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download/upload).

Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) / power backup capability for late-night mid-shift stability.



What We Offer



Competitive compensation package negotiable based on experience (base pay, non-taxable allowances, HMO healthcare coverage, and performance incentives).



Fixed Monday–Friday schedule (UK daytime hours: 9 AM – 6 PM UK time).



100% remote position with optional co-working pass support for power/internet backup.



Direct executive career path to build, recruit, and lead a dedicated offshore BPO operations and customer support department in the Philippines as the marketplace expands.

We are looking for a proactive and organized Project and Onboarding Manager to oversee the successful onboarding, training, and performance tracking of our LinkedIn Specialists. This role will ensure alignment with project goals, optimize workflows, and foster a smooth transition for newly hired specialists as they integrate into our team and client processes.

• Competitive salary

• Supportive and collaborative team environment
