title: SEO & Website Assistant (Framer)
description:
We are a growing international B2B SaaS startup looking for a reliable and tech-savvy SEO & Website Assistant to help manage, maintain, and continuously improve our website built with Framer.



Our website is already live, and we have documented our SEO goals and requirements.



We need someone with practical SEO knowledge who can implement improvements, work independently, and take care of our website on an ongoing basis.



Your Responsibilities



Framer Website Management: Update pages, content, layouts, metadata, and website elements directly in Framer.



Technical SEO: Check and improve indexing, sitemaps, redirects, canonical tags, internal linking, and other technical SEO elements.



On-Page SEO: Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and content structure.



AI Search Optimization (GEO): Help improve website visibility in AI-powered search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI search experiences.



Website Maintenance: Regularly check for broken links, errors, performance issues, and opportunities for improvement.



SEO Monitoring: Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and other SEO tools to monitor website performance.



Content Updates: Publish and optimize landing pages, blog articles, and other website content.



Continuous Improvement: Identify SEO issues, suggest practical improvements, and implement them.



Requirements



Practical knowledge of SEO fundamentals.



Experience using Framer or strong experience with similar no-code website builders.



Understanding of technical SEO and on-page optimization.



Familiarity with Google Search Console.



Basic understanding of how websites are indexed and ranked.



Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools for research and implementation.



Ability to work independently and follow existing documentation.



Good English communication skills.



Detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive.



Nice to have (not required):



Previous experience with B2B SaaS websites.



Knowledge of GEO / AI Search Optimization.



Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.



Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, or structured data (
).



Experience with Google Analytics 4.



What We're Looking For



We value practical skills over certifications or years of experience.



You don't need to be an SEO expert. However, you should understand SEO fundamentals, know how to identify common website issues, and be comfortable implementing improvements.



You should be someone who can research solutions, use AI tools effectively, and take ownership of assigned tasks without constant supervision.



We want someone who can become our long-term go-to person for everything related to our website and SEO implementation.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Executive Virtual Assistant (Dental Industry Experience Required) – Remote



Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred



We are seeking a highly reliable, task-oriented Executive Virtual Assistant to directly support a high-level executive in the dental industry. This role is focused on day-to-day executive support, helping manage tasks, patient communications, and operational follow-ups so the executive can move efficiently through the workday.



The ideal candidate is self-directed, organized, and able to work independently, while taking ownership of assigned responsibilities and seeing tasks through to completion.



Primary Responsibilities



-Provide daily administrative and operational support to the executive

-Manage incoming and outgoing phone calls on behalf of the executive

-Call back patients and handle scheduling requests professionally

-Perform insurance verifications and assist with insurance-related tasks

-Complete 10–20 outbound calls per day to:

 ***New patient lead lists

 ***Patients who have not returned for follow-up care

-Re-engage patients and successfully schedule appointments

-Monitor and respond to inquiries from our online chatbot and scheduling app

-Track patient messages and convert inquiries into booked appointments

title: Cybersecurity Engineer / Penetration Tester (AI-Assisted Security) - Full-Time or Part-Time
description:
Find the holes in our systems before anyone else does, and use AI to do it faster and at scale.



ABOUT US

We are a content creation and online coaching business running a lot of automation, AI agents, APIs, websites and cloud servers. We need a security expert who can test and harden all of it, and who knows how to leverage AI (LLMs, agents, automation) to make security work faster.



We are hiring for multiple positions. Full-time and part-time both welcome.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Run authorized penetration tests on our own web apps, APIs, servers and cloud setup

- Find, document and help fix vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth, misconfigurations, exposed secrets)

- Harden our Linux servers, VPS / cloud accounts, and access controls

- Review the security of our AI agents and automations: prompt injection, tool misuse, data leakage, API key handling

- Use AI and scripting to automate recon, scanning, log review and reporting

- Set up monitoring and alerting so we know when something is wrong

- Write clear reports with priorities and fixes the team can act on



MUST HAVE

- Hands-on pentesting experience (web / API / network)

- Comfortable with tools like Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, OWASP ZAP or similar

- Strong Linux and networking fundamentals

- Python or Bash scripting

- Practical experience using AI / LLMs in your security workflow

- Ethical, discreet and trustworthy; you only test what you are authorized to test



NICE TO HAVE

- Certifications such as OSCP, PNPT, eJPT, CEH, Security+ or similar

- Bug bounty track record (HackerOne, Bugcrowd, etc.)

- Cloud security (AWS / GCP), secrets management

- Knowledge of LLM / AI security (prompt injection, OWASP Top 10 for LLM apps)



PAY: Up to PHP 30,000/month (full-time), based on skill and certifications. Part-time pro-rated.



HOW WE HIRE

Screen on the "To apply" ask below, then a call, then a short PAID scoped test, then a small contract, then ongoing.



TO APPLY

1. Describe one real vulnerability you found (anonymized is fine): how you found it, impact, and how it was fixed.

2. Tell us how you use AI in your security work.

3. List your certifications or bug bounty profile, if any.

Applications with only a CV are skipped.

title: Video Editor for Instagram Reels (CapCut, Template-Based, Long-Term)
description:

We need a reliable CapCut editor who turns our raw talking videos into finished Instagram Reels, in quantity, every week, at consistent quality. We supply the footage, text, fonts, colors, brand rules and reference videos of the formats we like. You recreate those formats in CapCut, we approve them, and from then on you use them for every video.



1. RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Recreate our recurring formats from reference videos (text over b-roll, talking-head, yapping reels, method and list videos, tier rankings, this-or-that, good/better/best, side-by-side and more) as reusable CapCut templates. We approve each one before you use it.

2. Format supplied videos for 9:16 and make basic cuts.

3. Generate English auto-captions and correct every mistake.

4. Apply approved templates, fonts, colors and branding exactly as agreed.

5. Add supplied hooks, banners and on-screen text.

6. Export a thumbnail frame from the finished video.

7. Export, upload to Google Drive and update the Google Sheet.



2. WHAT WE NEED



You know CapCut well and you work fast. Once a template is approved, a standard 60s talking-head Reel must not take you 1h from raw file to upload-ready, captions checked. You keep that pace across a high volume of videos, week after week, without quality dropping.



This is repetitive, template-based work, so it is fast. We do not need fancy editing, motion graphics or Mr Beast style. If you enjoy creative, complex edits, this is not the role for you.



You check your own work before sending it and catch caption errors, sync problems, misalignments and anything unfinished. You solve small problems yourself and only reach out when you need a decision from us. You reply within 24 hours and tell us early if you cannot deliver on time.



You also need good English comprehension, your own computer and reliable internet.



3. WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



1. Long-term, remote, part-time role.

2. 10+ hours per week, with room to grow.

3. High output, delivered in batches.

4. Turnaround: 48 hours per batch.

5. Rate: $8-10 USD per hour, depending on experience and performance. Later on can be paid per piece delivered.

6. Tools: CapCut, Canva, Google Drive, Google Sheets and WhatsApp.



4. HOW WE HIRE



1. Apply: Start your message with the word CHECKED to show that you've read the post. Send link to your portfolio and your CV. Nothing else.

2. Short form: If your work fits, we send you a Google Form with a few more questions.

3. Interview: A short video call.

4. Paid trial: A short paid trial (a few hours) with our real content and reference videos, before any ongoing work begins.



Looking forward to hearing from you!

We are looking for someone who can research and find strong creators and communities for potential plush collaborations.





========================================

ROLE OVERVIEW

========================================



Your job is to find creators, brands, games, and online communities that could realistically become successful plush products.



This is NOT just about finding large creators.



We are specifically looking for creators with:



- Recognizable mascots, avatars, characters, creatures, memes, or other visual identities

- Strong and active communities

- Clear potential for a plush product

- Enough audience and buying potential for a successful product



The most important question is:



“Would fans realistically buy this as a plush product?”





========================================

IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS

========================================



A good lead MUST meet these requirements:



1. The creator must be ACTIVE

No dead channels, abandoned accounts, or creators with long upload breaks.



2. The creator/community must have enough buying potential

The audience should be large and engaged enough that selling 200+ plush units is realistically possible.



3. The creator should NOT already sell plush merchandise

We are specifically looking for creators who currently do not already sell plush products.



4. There must be a strong plush concept

The creator must have at least one of the following:

- Mascot

- Avatar

- Inside joke

- Character

- Meme

- Creature

- Recognizable visual identity



And it must be something that could realistically be turned into a strong and appealing plush product.



We are NOT looking for:

- Generic influencers with no recognizable visual identity

- Inactive creators

- Tiny communities with no buying potential

- Random gaming creators with no mascot/character potential





========================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

========================================



- Research creators, brands, games, and communities

- Find strong plush collaboration opportunities

-Identifying the specific mascot, character, avatar, meme, creature, or visual identity that could become a plush

- Evaluating whether the community has realistic potential to buy the product

- Collect contact details/socials

- Organizing your research and findings clearly





========================================

REQUIREMENTS

========================================



- Good internet research skills

- Understanding of online communities and creator culture

- An understanding of YouTube, gaming, and content creators

- Attention to detail

- Good English communication skills

-The ability to recognize opportunities beyond simple follower counts





========================================

WORK DETAILS

========================================



- 4 hours per day

- Flexible schedule





========================================

HOW TO APPLY

========================================



Please include:



1. Short introduction

2. Relevant experience

3. Contact information 
 etc.)



IMPORTANT:

- Who they are

title: You've Built Skool Communities Before. Now Run Ours - Part-Time Skool Community Manager ($500/mo + Growth Bonuses)
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "SKOOL OPERATOR" IN CAPITAL LETTERS ON THE FIRST LINE. Anything else gets deleted unread.



This role is only for people who have already built Skool communities and run them right now. If you have never set up a Skool group yourself, please do not apply. I will check.



THE SITUATION

We are an established brand with an active community that lives on an old-school forum today. We are moving it to Skool. The members are real, the brand is real, and the content exists. What we do not have is the person who knows exactly how to make a Skool community work: how to move people over without losing them, how to get them posting, how to keep them for months, and how to grow it.



That person runs it. Not "helps with it." Runs it.



WHAT YOU OWN

- The migration: plan the move from the forum to Skool, set up the group (categories, classroom, calendar, levels, gamification, onboarding), and get the existing members across and active

- Retention: you know why people go quiet in week 2 and leave in month 2, and you have a system that stops it

- Engagement: daily presence, conversation starters, welcomes, events and calls, recognizing members, keeping the feed alive without it feeling forced

- Content direction: you tell ME what content the community needs - what to post, what to put in the classroom, what calls to run - based on what members actually respond to

- Growth: you are responsible for growing membership, and you know which levers actually move it

- Reporting: a simple weekly update with the numbers that matter - new members, active members, churn, what worked, what you are changing



WHO YOU ARE

- You have personally built more than one Skool community and you manage at least one today

- You can show me numbers: members, activity, retention or churn - not just screenshots of a pretty group

- You are super organized. You run on systems, checklists and calendars, not memory. I should never have to chase you

- You think like an operator, not a moderator. You make decisions, you test things, you own the result

- Clear, warm, natural written English, because you are the voice members talk to every day



THE DEAL

- Part time, about 4 hours a day on average, with flexibility on when, as long as the community is covered

- $500/month base

- Bonuses on top, tied to membership growth and retention KPIs. We set the exact targets together once the community is live on Skool and we have a baseline. Grow it and keep people, and you earn more



WHAT I NEED IN YOUR APPLICATION

Short answers are fine. Real answers are required.

1. Links to the Skool communities you built or manage. For each one: your role, how many members, free or paid, and how long you have run it.

2. Your best retention or engagement number from a community you ran, and what you did to get it.

3. An established forum community moves to Skool. 400 members join in week one and most of them never post. What exactly do you do in the first 14 days?

4. What are the 3 things most Skool community owners get wrong?



If you cannot answer #1 with real links, this is not your role.



Start your message with SKOOL OPERATOR and answer all four.

title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot/GHL, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot/GHL reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

1. In one paragraph, tell us about yourself.

2. What are your key strengths that would help you excel in this role?

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?



Don’t just look for a job - build a meaningful career filled with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.



Apply today!

title: Cold Caller/Outbound Sales Specialist (AI Virtual Receptionist Agency)

title: Online English/World History Teachers (Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.



Qualifications



Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

KeaBabies is seeking a practical, execution-focused Product Designer to strengthen our design capabilities by translating customer needs, and market opportunities into supplier-feasible product improvements. title: Senior Brand Manager needed to support 10+ Amazon brands for growth, execution, drive performance and operation
description:
About Prodigy Media



Prodigy Media is an established e-commerce company with over a decade of experience developing, launching, and scaling private-label brands, primarily on Amazon USA.



We manage a diverse portfolio of brands across multiple categories and are looking for an experienced Senior Amazon Brand Manager to take ownership of brand performance, identify growth opportunities, and lead day-to-day execution.



We're looking for someone with extensive Amazon marketplace experience who understands how to grow brands, improve profitability, launch products successfully, and coordinate teams to get results.



This is a senior-level position for someone who can think strategically, solve problems independently, and take ownership of performance.



We're also embracing modern AI tools to help our team work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Experience with Claude, Codex, or automation tools is highly valued, but strong Amazon brand management experience is our number one priority.



Key Responsibilities



1. Amazon Brand Management & Growth

You'll be responsible for overseeing and improving the performance of assigned Amazon private-label brands.

Manage multiple Amazon brands and product portfolios.

Analyze sales, profitability, organic rankings, conversion rates, traffic, and advertising performance.

Identify opportunities to increase revenue, improve margins, and grow market share.

Develop and execute strategies to improve underperforming products.

Oversee listing optimization, SEO, A+ Content, Brand Stores, and conversion improvements.

Conduct competitive analysis and identify market opportunities.

Monitor inventory-related issues that affect sales and performance.

Develop clear short-term and long-term growth strategies for assigned brands.

Our expectation: You don't just maintain Amazon listings. You actively manage and grow the business.



2. Data Analysis, Problem Solving & Execution



Strong analytical skills are essential, but identifying problems is only the beginning.

We're looking for someone who can:

Analyze data to identify declining sales, poor conversion rates, advertising inefficiencies, and other performance issues.

Investigate the underlying causes rather than simply reporting numbers.

Develop practical solutions supported by research and data.

Implement corrective actions and coordinate the necessary resources.

Monitor results and continuously improve strategies.

Take responsibility for resolving issues from beginning to end.

We don't need someone who simply tells us what's wrong. We need someone who knows how to fix it and takes action.



3. Amazon Product Launches



You must have direct, hands-on experience launching private-label products on Amazon.

Responsibilities include:

Conducting product and competitor research.

Performing keyword research and analyzing market opportunities.

Developing product launch strategies, budgets, and timelines.

Coordinating product photography, listing content, A+ Content, and launch assets.

Working with PPC specialists on launch campaigns and advertising strategies.

Planning compliant product review acquisition strategies.

Coordinating inventory readiness and launch schedules.

Monitoring launch performance and optimizing strategies to improve rankings, conversions, and sales.

You should understand the complete Amazon launch process, from preparation to successful market entry and continued growth.



4. Team Coordination & Project Management



You'll work directly with our PPC specialists, graphic designers, and operations team to ensure brand initiatives are completed effectively.

Coordinate PPC strategies and campaign priorities with advertising specialists.

Work closely with graphic designers to develop listing images, A+ Content, advertising creatives, and product videos.

Assign projects, set clear priorities, and establish realistic due dates.

Manage multiple ongoing projects and ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

Review creative assets and campaign initiatives to ensure they support brand objectives.

Identify bottlenecks and resolve delays before they affect performance.

Maintain accountability and clear communication across teams.

Use project management systems to organize assignments, responsibilities, and deadlines.

You must be comfortable leading execution, making decisions, and ensuring that important work gets completed without constant supervision.



5. External Marketing & Brand Development



While Amazon is our main sales channel, we also want to expand our brand presence and customer acquisition efforts beyond Amazon.

Experience or familiarity with the following is valuable:

 and Instagram advertising.

TikTok marketing and short-form video content.

Influencer marketing and UGC creators.

External traffic strategies that drive customers to Amazon.

Affiliate marketing and customer acquisition campaigns.

Shopify and direct-to-consumer marketing.

We're looking for someone who understands how to use outside marketing channels to build brand awareness and support Amazon sales growth.



6. AI Tools, Automation & Operational Improvements



We're continuously improving our business through AI and modern technology.

While this is not a software development position, we value Amazon professionals who are comfortable using AI to improve their productivity and solve business problems.

Experience with the following is a strong advantage:

Claude and Claude Code.

OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT.

AI-assisted Amazon research, analytics, and reporting.

Automating repetitive business tasks and workflows.

Building or customizing simple internal tools using AI.

We especially value people who are willing to invest time in exploring AI-powered applications or automations that eliminate operational bottlenecks and help the company operate more efficiently.



Minimum Qualifications



Required:

At least 4 years of proven Amazon brand management experience, preferably managing US private-label brands.

Demonstrated experience growing Amazon sales and improving brand performance.

Direct experience successfully launching new products on Amazon.

Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and advertising fundamentals.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into practical solutions.

Experience coordinating with PPC specialists, graphic designers, and other team members.

Excellent project management skills, including assigning priorities and meeting deadlines.

Good understanding of Amazon profitability, margins, conversion rates, and organic rankings.

Familiarity with external marketing strategies.

Strong English communication and independent problem-solving skills.



Highly Preferred:



Experience managing multiple Amazon brands simultaneously.

Advanced knowledge of Data Dive, Helium 10, and Amazon Brand Analytics.

Experience with Meta, TikTok, influencer marketing, or UGC campaigns.

Practical experience using Claude, Codex, and other AI tools.

Experience creating automations, dashboards, or simple internal business applications.

Familiarity with ClickUp, Notion, and workflow management systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a proactive, results-driven Amazon professional who:

Understands what drives profitable Amazon brand growth.

Can manage multiple brands and identify the right priorities.

Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they're resolved.

Works effectively with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Can independently coordinate projects, deadlines, and resources.

Is constantly looking for opportunities to improve business performance.

Is open to adopting AI tools and developing more efficient systems.



As an experienced Amazon Brand Manager first, with a strong interest in using technology to become even more effective.



What Success Looks Like

During your first 90 days, we expect you to:

Develop a clear understanding of your assigned brands and their performance.

Identify the biggest opportunities to improve sales, profitability, and conversion rates.

Create actionable growth plans with measurable objectives.

Resolve high-priority issues affecting brand performance.

Establish effective coordination with PPC specialists and graphic designers.

Improve project accountability and timely delivery of creative and marketing initiatives.

Demonstrate strong ownership, independent decision-making, and measurable progress.

Identify opportunities where AI tools or automation could make existing workflows more efficient.



Most importantly, you take ownership of the results.



If this sounds like you and you would like to apply. Please send your resume directly to myself with the subject line : SBM with Passion for AI





Tam Ma

Co Founder - Prodigy Media

title: Cruise & Guest Services Specialist (Full-Time, Remote, EST)
description:
We are adding several positions as we are continuing to expand our team--Cruise & Guest Services Virtual Assistant / Specialist 



Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Eastern Time (EST) 



Starting Rate: $5/hour 

Schedule: 40 hours/week 

Growth Opportunity: Performance-based increases 



About Us 



We are a boutique travel agency based in Atlanta, GA (EST). We specialize in luxury river cruises — especially Viking and now AmaWaterways — and offer white-glove support for discerning clients. 

 

We're warm, organized, and passionate about creating unforgettable cruise experiences. Our team is small, collaborative, and committed to doing things right. 

 

We have documented processes (SOPs) for most tasks, so you won't be guessing. You'll be trained and supported, not thrown into the deep end. 

 

We're looking for a talented Client Care Assistant to join us full-time. 

 

Before You Apply: 



This Role Is Likely a Great Fit If: 



You have cruise guest services experience or strong travel booking experience 



You have supported luxury or high-touch clients 



You enjoy detailed administrative work 



You want a stable, long-term remote position 



You can confidently communicate with senior clients 



You take ownership of your work and ask questions when needed 



DO NOT Apply If: 



Your experience is limited to general hospitality roles such as bartending, serving, retail, or unrelated customer service positions 



You are not comfortable speaking with clients on the phone, and couldn't be understood clearly with senior & elderly clients.



You are looking for freelance, temporary, or part-time work. We are hiring long-term. (Our team stays for over 6 years!)

You submit generic applications without reviewing the requirements (we can always tell which is AI--all cover letters have the same phrases! Just be yourself).

Speaking with clients on the phone 



Drafting client
s (hold reminders, confirmation, follow-ups, courtesy responses, answer inquiries) 



Updating HubSpot and transitioning to Zoho CRM and internal trackers — keeping booking statuses, contact details, and notes current 



Calling Viking Cruises and clients to verify information, request itineraries, or resolve booking questions 



Supporting the CEO and team with high-level administrative tasks 



Managing booking coordination from inquiry through post-travel follow-up

Guest/client emails are are drafts for review. 



You'll have autonomy for routine messages, with clear guidance on when to escalate (pricing, payments, sensitive situations). 



Some responses require an empathetic, reassuring tone; others follow standard templates. 



You'll be trained on our systems (HubSpot/Zoho, booking trackers, Outlook) and supported by an experienced team invested in your success. 

 



Who We're Looking For 



Must-Have Qualifications 



Experience in cruise guest services, travel bookings, or itinerary 



Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, polished, professional tone 



Comfortable speaking with clients on the phone 



Ability to work independently and manage detailed tasks remotely 



High attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability 



Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace 



Executive Assistant experience involving complex travel coordination may also qualify. 



Bonus Points:



River cruise experience 



Familiarity with Viking or AmaWaterways 



Experience using the MyViking Journey (MVJ) Travel Advisor Portal or AmaWaterways 



HubSpot/Zoho CRM experience (or fast learner with CRMs) 



Experience with booking portals, invoices, or guest information systems 



Strong time management and comfort with documented SOP 



Schedule:



Target Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST 



For applicants in the Philippines, this is an evening/night shift schedule. Please ensure this works for you before applying. 



Hours may vary based on business needs. 



Saturday coverage may occasionally be required after training and will be handled through team rotation. 



How to Apply: 



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We use this process to assess attention to detail, communication skills, and genuine interest in the role. 



Step 1 



Include the phrase: "Smooth Sailing" in your subject line or opening sentence. 



Step 2 



Submit a 1–2 minute video introduction (Required). Applications without a video introduction will not be reviewed. 



Your video should:

Share why you're passionate about travel support or river cruising 



Describe what excites you about working with a team like ours 



Step 3 



Attach your resume/CV. (If using Google Drive, ensure access is granted) 



We're excited to meet someone who genuinely cares about delivering excellent travel service and wants to grow with a supportive team. 



If that sounds like you — smooth sailing ahead.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: Customer Support Specialist (Phone & Email)
description:
Who We Are

Raicom LLC is a US-based e-commerce company that has been around for ~7 years. Our main brand is in health and wellness, our business is growing, and our customer and subscriber base keeps increasing.

Hence, we're hiring 3 Customer Support Specialists for phone and
. You'll help customers with orders, billing, refunds, and product questions, and give a little extra care to the ones who need more reassurance along the way.

More than fixing the problem, we believe customers remember how we made them feel. 



What you'll do

- Be the voice customers trust. Take inbound calls and answer
s about orders, shipping, billing, refunds, replacements, etc

- Listen first. Understand what's really going on before you offer a fix

- Turn a rough moment into a good one. Bring a calm, warm presence to customers who need extra reassurance

- Make the call. Use your judgment inside clear guidelines to find the right resolution

- See it through. Stay with the customer until it's resolved, and follow up when something needs a second touch.



You'll be a strong fit if you

- Speak clear English and are easy to understand on a phone line.

- Have 1–2+ years in customer service, call center, or BPO work (voice experience is a plus)

- Have handled upset customers, or stay unusually composed under pressure

- Listen for what a customer actually needs, not just the first thing they say

- Are comfortable making reasonable decisions inside established guidelines

- Stay empathetic without losing control of the call

- Have stable high-speed internet (>100mbps) and a quiet, professional workspace

- Can work during US business hours



What you get

- $7/hour

- Full-time, 100% remote, fixed shift

- Health insurance

- Paid time off

- Year-end bonus

- Yearly salary increase



How to apply



Send an application with a subject line "Raicom CS - VR". Record a video and upload it to Google Drive and set the link to "anyone with the link can view."



In the video:



1. Read this aloud: "Thank you for holding. I've found your order, number
. It was placed on the twelfth of March, and it shipped on the fourteenth. The package was marked delivered at 4:15 on Friday, but I understand you never received it. I'm very sorry about that. I can ship a replacement today, or refund seventy-two dollars and fifty cents. Which would you like?"



2. Answer these questions in your own words. Don't read your answers. Just talk to us:

    ◦ Think of a great or terrible customer experience you've had. What made it stand out?

    ◦ Tell us about your favorite meal and how it's made.

    ◦ Describe your hometown to someone who has never been there.

    ◦ Walk us through how you prepare for a night shift.



Excited to meet you!

You will work with leadership and our marketing and design team. This is a dedicated 40-hour-per-week position with room to take greater ownership as you learn the business. We want someone who can contribute ideas, follow through, and help move campaigns forward.

title: Full-Stack WordPress Developer
description:
ABOUT BRAND M3DIA



Brand M3dia is a Canadian technology company specializing in interactive kiosks, AI robots, digital signage, custom software, websites, and automation. We serve clients across Canada and the United States.



Approximately 80% of our past website work has been WordPress. We’re expanding into custom web applications and AI-powered solutions, and we’re looking for a developer who can support both.



THE ROLE



We need a hands-on developer who can handle front-end and back-end development, build polished Elementor websites, troubleshoot existing projects, and create custom functionality.



We encourage AI-assisted development and vibe coding. You must understand, test, debug, and maintain the code you deliver.



You’ll work with our project manager, designers, marketing team, and leadership to turn approved ideas into reliable websites and working tools.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Build and maintain WordPress websites using Elementor Pro and custom code.

• Turn approved designs into polished, responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile pages.

• Develop custom functionality using PHP, JavaScript, WordPress hooks, child themes, and plugins.

• Build landing pages, calculators, lead-capture tools, and simple web applications.

• Connect websites and forms to CRMs and other platforms through APIs and webhooks.

• Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, broken layouts, failed integrations, and performance issues.

• Manage staging sites, updates, backups, migrations, and deployment checks.

• Use AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.

• Test your work and provide clear handover notes.



REQUIRED SKILLS



• Strong WordPress and Elementor Pro experience.

• Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.

• Experience building custom functionality beyond installing plugins.

• Working knowledge of MySQL and safe database operations.

• Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication.

• Git version control using GitHub or an equivalent platform.

• Understanding of responsive design, website performance, accessibility basics, and security.

• Experience with staging environments, backups, and rollback procedures.

• Practical experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent tools.

• Clear English communication and strong troubleshooting skills.



You must be comfortable taking over existing websites and code, understanding how they work, and improving them.



BONUS SKILLS



• React, Next.js, or another modern front-end framework.

• Node.js or Python.

• 
, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.

• Zoho CRM, AI APIs, or chatbot integrations.

• Technical SEO, analytics, and conversion tracking.

• Touchscreen interfaces or browser-based kiosk applications.



You do not need experience with every bonus tool.



HOW WE WORK



• Submit a short daily plan and keep your Basecamp tasks updated.

• Provide an end-of-day report with completed work, links or screenshots, remaining tasks, and blockers.

• Confirm requirements and realistic timelines before starting substantial work.

• Raise problems early, explain what you’ve tried, and recommend a next step.

• Follow through on outstanding tasks without repeated reminders.

• Test layouts, forms, integrations, and relevant error cases before marking work complete.

• Keep code and documentation organized in company-controlled accounts.

• Follow company rules for client data, credentials, and AI tools.



We value initiative, clear communication, and reliable follow-through. “Done” means the work functions, has been checked, and is ready for review.



WHY JOIN US?



• Work on websites, interactive technology, and practical AI projects.

• Collaborate with designers, marketing, and technical teammates.

• Help improve our tools and development processes.

• Opportunity for long-term growth across software and automation projects.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line:

Full-Stack WordPress Developer — [Your Name]



Include the following:



Your résumé.



Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Your earliest start date and available working hours, including your overlap with Toronto time.



Two WordPress websites you personally developed. For each, briefly explain what you built yourself.



One example of custom PHP/JavaScript, an API integration, or a back-end feature you developed.



A link to the short video described below.



If your projects are private, a redacted walkthrough is welcome. Do not share confidential client code or credentials.



REQUIRED VIDEO — 4–6 MINUTES



Record a simple introduction and screen-share video using Loom or a similar tool. No editing or polished presentation is needed. We want to understand your experience, how you think, and what you personally built.



Please answer these questions:



Tell us briefly about yourself, your development experience, and why this role interests you.



Show one WordPress project you’re proud of. What did you personally build, and which parts used Elementor versus custom code?



Describe a back-end feature or API integration you developed. What happened to the data after the user submitted or requested it?



Which AI coding tools do you use? Give one real example of how AI helped you and how you checked or corrected its output.



Describe a difficult bug you solved. How did you identify the cause and verify the fix?



If a task is blocked or likely to miss its deadline, how do you communicate that and keep the work moving?



Please check that your video link is accessible without requesting permission.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a live project walkthrough and a paid practical assessment.



AI tools are allowed during the assessment. You must be able to explain your code, demonstrate that it works, and make a small change live.



Applications without relevant project examples, answers to the requested application details, and the required video will not be considered.

title: HIRING ASAP: Experienced AI Video Editor – ₱75,000/Month + Bonuses
description:
Most editing jobs hand you footage and a deadline.



This one hands you a script. You create everything else.



We're a fast-growing DTC health & beauty brand.



We scale on Meta cold traffic, so the creative is the business. A winning ad pays for months. A loser dies in 48 hours.

We need someone who can build ads out of nothing but AI tools and taste.



Why work for us:



- You earn on every winner. Base salary plus a bonus on every ad that wins. Your ads get real budget. When they perform, you get paid for it. Month after month, as long as it runs.



- You'll get seriously good at this. You'll learn direct response creative from people spending real money every week. Hooks, pacing, angles, why a 3-second open d
 everything. You'll see the performance data on everything you make. Most editors never find out if their work worked. You will.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a Direct Response Video Editor to join our team! As our video editor, you will be responsible for editing, producing, and managing multiple creative projects with a heavy focus on paid ad creatives for Meta Platforms - VSLs, short and long form. You'll take raw UGC and transform it into high-converting direct response ads that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience editing paid ads, understands direct response principles, runs a current AI stack in production, and delivers volume and quality in the same week without being chased.



Who are we?

KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space — $22M+ in revenue and targeting $45-50M in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.



What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.



If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands-on and active, all while having a generous performance bonus structure — then you've come to the right place.



Key Objectives

Consistent output of 8 ad briefs per week, maintaining volume and quality simultaneously.

Increase your performance bonus by analyzing prior video metrics to increase views and conversions.

Apply direct-response copywriting principles to review scripts.

Operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your daily workload efficiently to meet deadlines without needing hand-holding or frequent check-ins.

Quickly learn and master new tools and software, and editing techniques as social media trends evolve, often with less than a day's notice.

Ensure every video meets our exacting quality standards and perfectly matches the provided instructions, minimizing the need for revisions.

Maintain clear, proactive communication with the company founders and executive team, providing updates when necessary.

Create ad variations and iterations to scale winning ads and improve performance.

Collaborate with the creative strategy team to bring ad concepts to life.

Apply direct response marketing principles to editing (hooks, problem/solution flow, testimonials, CTAs).

Stay up to date on internet trends and editing styles to ensure our ads feel native and engaging.



Requirements

Fully remote.

Fluent in English.

Proven experience creating short-form direct-response videos for DTC brands.

Proven experience with professional video-editing software is required. We have a strong preference for Adobe Premiere Pro

Paid Ad Focus: Proven experience editing Meta/Facebook paid ads that convert.

Volume: Comfortable producing 8 ad briefs per week.

Tools: Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro

Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to combine storytelling with data-driven feedback to refine and improve ads.

No issue working overtime or on weekends if needed. You're passionate about your work and excited by the idea of producing ads that millions will see.

Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.

Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.

Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories.

Meta VSLs: Proven experience with short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run.

AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production, not one you tried once.

Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.



KPI'S you will own

8 ad briefs per week Quota

80% First-Pass Approval Rate: At least 80% of submissions require no revisions.



Accountabilities

Deliver 8 ad briefs per week

Edit VSLs and DR video ads with AI-first workflows

Weekly iterations on top-performing ads to drive continuous improvement.

Ensure ads are visually compelling, on-brand, and optimized for performance.

Stay plugged into social media/UGC trends to keep our creatives fresh and competitive.

Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns by testing different edits, structures, and hooks.

Work fluently across AI video and UGC tools (Higgsfield, and similar)

Collaborate closely with strategists, copywriters, and performance teams



This Role Is Not For You If

You are a meticulous video perfectionist who will spend hours refining a single transition or effect. With a high daily quota, success in this role demands efficiency. Adhering perfectly to the video template at speed is valued over spending extra time on minor details that don't contribute to views or conversions.

You thrive in highly collaborative, team-oriented environments with frequent meetings and brainstorming sessions. This is a high-autonomy, "heads-down" role where you will be working independently the majority of the time to meet your individual production goals.

You are a methodical planner who prefers stable, long-term projects and predictable workflows. Our environment is inherently dynamic. The tools, guidelines, and video styles can change overnight, and you must be able to pivot instantly without frustration.



How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

We review applications on a rolling basis. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens up, exceptional candidates may be hired immediately. 

Our process has three stages:

(1) Application Review + Screening - we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit. 

(2) Technical Interview + Creative Brief - a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work. 

(3) Culture Fit Interview - a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us. 

KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.

For this role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business — and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed.

Salary Expectation



USD $1,000 - $1,500 per month (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.

We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta only.



In Order to apply - fill in our application form:

description:

_________________________________________________

Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - one of the fastest-growing home brands in the US, redefining how people experience modern dining and everyday elegance.



Our vision is simple: when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware (with household appliances on the way), they think JazzUpCo. We’ve already served over 100,000 customers and are now building a global, design-first homeware brand.



At JazzUpCo, growth comes from turning great ideas into great execution. As we continue to scale across multiple channels - from Shopify and Amazon to retail and wholesale - strong operations become increasingly important. 



We’re looking for a proactive, curious Admin & Operations Assistant to join our team! 



In this role, you’ll be the glue that keeps our day-to-day running smoothly, helping manage everything from admin and multi-country compliance to e-commerce fulfillment and inventory tracking. If you're naturally curious, detail-oriented, and love bringing order to day-to-day workflows, we’d love to hear from you! 

_________________________________________________

Role Overview:



Administrative role:

- Support in recruitment and onboarding process, including creating job postings, screening candidates, coordinating interviews and preparing onboarding materials.



- Maintain internal FAQs, and maintain SOP documentation to keep team resources up to date. 



- Handle routine payments (suppliers, affiliates, expenses), audit shipping invoices and sales tax data for discrepancies. 



- Maintain an organised compliance calendar to ensure timely statutory, legal, and tax filings across Singapore, Canada, and the US. 



- Gather required financial data, prepare filing packages, and coordinate with our Business Support staff to ensure error-free submissions.



- Monitor software subscription renewal schedules, conduct market research for alternative tools and coordinate vendor demos.



- Coordinate internal team communications, manage routine approval requests, and assist with periodic company updates.



Operations role:

- Maintain inventory planning sheets, including forecasting, stock planning and shipment tracking.



- Monitor fulfilment and regularly audit orders to ensure they are processed accurately and on time.



- Maintain operational trackers for claims, missing inventory, packaging accuracy and other fulfilment issues, etc.



- Identify any inefficiencies or potential issues, and provide insights on how we can improve our operational processes and systems.



- Support B2B operations, including database cleanup, software administration and the fulfilment of wholesale orders.

_________________________________________________

You’re a Fit If You Have:

- You have a natural curiosity to dig into unfamiliar topics and find clear answers online independently.



- Natural organizer who ensures processes are followed and deliverables hit their target dates.



- You are comfortable working with spreadsheets, forecasting stock needs, auditing fulfillment issues, and keeping tabs on 3PL packaging accuracy and wholesale orders.



- Able to work independently without hand-holding, with a keen eye for detail that spots mistakes, typos, or stock count errors before they cause issues.



- Adaptable team player who thrives switching between admin tasks and operations support.

_________________________________________________

Why Join JazzUpCo?

- 100% Remote



- Fast Growth, Real Ownership – Your work directly impacts our product performance and global expansion.



- Paid Time Off & Benefits



-Learning & Career Path – Learn directly from the founder and consultants and growing into a senior Admin & Ops executive. 



- Growth-Focused Culture – We’re big on learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.



- Not just a number in the org chart – Every team member is heard, supported, and part of the journey and your voice is actually heard.

_________________________________________________

Our Culture: E-F-G



E - Excel

We don’t believe in coasting. If we’re going to do something, we do it well - with care, thought, and pride in the details.



F - Fulfilment

It’s not just about the work we do - it’s how we feel doing it. We build things that excite us, challenge us, and make us proud.



G - Growth

The best journeys bring out your best. This role is designed to sharpen your skills, push your thinking, and grow with you - with mentorship, feedback, and the space to lead.

_________________________________________________



Next Steps:

2) First Interview → Get to know each other

3) Trial Task → Show us how you think and execute

4) Join the Team → Onboarding + probation → full-time hire

title: Senior WordPress Developer, Half Time, Long Term
description:
We are an Australian branding and marketing agency managing around 30 WordPress sites for our clients. We are hiring an experienced, motivated WordPress developer to maintain our existing sites and build our new sites.



The role has two parts.



1. Builds and amendments.

New sites and pages from finished designs, plus the day to day queue: content updates, blog posts, events, forms, and on page SEO on everything you publish.



2. Maintenance and security.

Backups, uptime, security hardening, and fixing whatever breaks. Routine plugin updates are handled by another developer, so your focus is the standard, the response, and the builds.



If running a fleet of WordPress websites properly sounds like a job you would actually enjoy, keep reading.



You should have:



WordPress

- 5 or more years of professional WordPress development.

- Strong page builder skills. We use a modern visual builder; if you are good in Elementor, Divi or similar, you will pick ours up quickly.

- Comfortable using ACF and custom fields.

- Solid WordPress security knowledge and good on page SEO habits.



Development

- PHP and JavaScript you can genuinely read and write.

- Methodical debugging when a live site breaks.

- Experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor is a plus. We use them daily.

- Experience building automation systems in tools like Go High Level and Notion is a plus.



How you work

- An incredible eye for detail and for checking over your own work.

- Excellent written English.



Practical

- A reliable computer and a backup internet connection. An Apple Mac is preferred but not essential.

- Available to start within four weeks.



The offer

- 4 hours a day with overtime, Monday to Friday. Philippine daytime hours work well with our timezone. With the option to move into full-time within a year 

- $600 to $900 USD per month, depending on experience.

- Paid monthly on the 5th of each month.

- Philippine regular holidays, 10 days paid leave, and 13th month pay after your first year.

- Salary review at 12 months.

- Fully remote, long term role.

- The option to work 6 hours a day instead of 8, salary pro rata.



To apply



There are two steps. We only interview candidates who complete both, and interview invitations are based on your application and your assessment results together.



Step 1. 



Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph with the word 'Mango' in your subject line. Start your application by answering the below questions:

2. How many years of professional development experience do you have in total?

4. Have you built anything with an AI coding tool? Tell us about the coolest thing: what does it do, and how did you build it? (Optional, but we love seeing this.)

title: Influencer Marketing Executive
description:
We are a baby and maternity brand with customers based in the USA, Canada, and Europe. We are a young and dynamic growing E-commerce company, looking for someone who is experienced, organized, reliable, and in it for the long run. If you are looking for a challenging, rewarding, and fulfilling career, we welcome you to apply for the job below.



Our working hour is from Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm GMT+8.



Job Overview:

We are seeking an Influencer Marketing Specialist to identify, engage, and build relationships with influencers who align with our brand. You will manage influencer outreach, oversee campaign deliverables, and track performance to drive impactful collaborations. The ideal candidate has 1–2 years of experience and a strong understanding of influencer marketing.



Job Description:

• Identify Influencers: Research and create a list of 30–50 influencers each week who align with our brand and niche, following our established influencer criteria

• Outreach and Communication: Initiate contact with influencers via
 templates, influencer management tools, or social media inboxes. Maintain regular and professional communication by addressing their inquiries, coordinating product shipments for product-for-post collaborations, and ensuring timely follow-ups

• Campaign Management: Oversee collaborations by tracking influencer deliverables, verifying that posts meet campaign requirements, and building long-term relationships with influencers

• Performance Tracking: Monitor influencer content and campaign performance, and provide feedback to refine our influencer marketing strategies

• Collaboration Coordination: Work closely with the marketing team to align influencer campaigns with broader social media, brand, and promotional objectives



Requirements:

• Experience: At least 1–2 years of experience in influencer marketing, social media management, or a related role. Experience with influencer management tools is a plus

• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills to build and maintain professional relationships with influencers and collaborators

• Organisational Skills: Ability to manage multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met

• Social Media Knowledge: Familiarity with major social media platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) and an understanding of their audiences and content styles

• Analytical Mindset: Experience in tracking campaign performance metrics, analysing influencer, and reporting insights to the team

• Creativity: A keen eye for content quality and creativity to identify influencers who align with the brand’s tone and aesthetic

• Team Player: A collaborative attitude and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams

• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in tools like Google Workspace, Excel, and influencer management platforms

• Attention to Detail: High attention to detail in managing communication, contracts, and content deliverables.

• Proactivity: A self-starter with the ability to take initiative, solve problems, and adapt to a fast-paced environment



Salary:

USD400 to USD600/month



Take note of the following:

1. Title your message: "I want to join KeaBabies as an Influencer Marketing Executive"

2. Share with us your experience with Influencer Marketing .

3. No moonlighting is allowed during work hours in this role.

You’ll keep schedules organized, communicate with customers and technicians, and resolve scheduling issues as they arise.

* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and cancel service appointments

* Dispatch technicians based on location, availability, service requirements, and workload

* Plan efficient routes and minimize unnecessary travel

* Monitor technician progress and adjust schedules throughout the day

* Coordinate urgent requests, recurring services, and follow-up visits

* Handle technician delays, absences, cancellations, and scheduling conflicts

* Answer customer calls, texts, and
s professionally

* Communicate appointment windows, technician ETAs, and schedule changes

* Strong spoken and written English

* Confident, professional customer phone communication

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through

* Experience using scheduling, dispatch, CRM, or field-service software

* Ability to work independently and follow established procedures

* Availability during U.S. business hours

STRONGLY PREFERRED

* Familiarity with recurring pest control treatments, reservices, and technician routing

OTHER RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



* Dispatching for HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, cleaning, landscaping, or property maintenance

description:

About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in the USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino team members and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for an Affiliate Content Manager to grow and run our network of affiliate creators: finding the right creators, getting them excited about Crafti, and making sure the content they post actually makes people buy.



This is an analytical role, not a creative one. You don't need years of experience. What matters is that you enjoy pulling videos apart to understand why some sell and others don't, and that you keep using what you learn to make the next round better.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Watch a TikTok or Reel and naturally break down why it worked or didn't: the hook, the first 3 seconds, the format, the comments

- Care more about whether a video sold the product than whether it looked nice

- Enjoy comparing results, spotting patterns and testing small changes to see what improves

- Can juggle dozens of creator conversations across DMs,
 and WhatsApp without letting anyone slip through the cracks

- Follow up and push things forward rather than wait to be told what's next

- Learn fast and pick up new tools (including AI) on your own



Do not apply if:



- You mainly see yourself as a creative and want to make your own content. This role is about analysing and improving content, not creating it.

- You don't use TikTok or Instagram regularly yourself

- You are uncomfortable being a project manager or following up with people who go quiet

- Your written English is not clear and professional. You will be writing to creators on our behalf.



What You'll Do



- Creator Sourcing: find and reach out to creators whose audience matches ours (women aged 25–35 who are into wellness, pilates and healthy routines)

- Affiliate Management: onboard creators, send free product, agree on terms and keep every creator moving from "interested" to "posted"

- Content Briefing: write clear briefs based on what has actually worked for us and what is trending right now

- Content Review: review creator content before it goes live and give specific feedback to improve it

- Performance Analysis: track how every post performs (views, clicks, sales), work out what the winners have in common, and feed that back into the next briefs

- Trend Watching: spot formats and trends we should test, and back up your suggestions with examples of how they are performing



What We Are Looking For



Skills:



- Strong understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and what makes people buy

- Organised: comfortable keeping trackers in Google Sheets or similar

- Clear, friendly written English

- Comfortable with tech tools and AI

- Bonus (not required): experience with influencer outreach, product gifting



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Urgency and ownership: today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done

- Proactive communicator: if something might go wrong, I flag it early

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way, and I back it up with evidence





Details



This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 75,000 per month



Commitment: Contract role with the option to extend if found to be suitable

Hours: Philippine business hours, Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm, with flexibility to reply to creators outside these hours

Manage project deadlines reliably to ensure consistent weekly content output.



Maintain strict quality control across typography, branding, audio leveling, and export parameters.



Collaborate and communicate proactively with our team members throughout the editing workflow.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Proven Track Record: Professional video editing experience (prior agency or marketing team background preferred).



Self-Starter: Ability to work autonomously, manage your queue, and make confident creative choices.



Social Media Insight: Solid understanding of hook strategies and retention-focused editing for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube.



Technical Mastery: High proficiency in color grading, audio enhancement, dynamic captioning, and music timing.



Creative Eye: Strong visual sense regarding composition, pacing, and premium aesthetic quality.



Consistency & Speed: Ability to maintain speed and high visual standards while delivering consistent monthly volume.



Communication: Strong written and spoken English skills with proactive updates.

(Optional / Plus)
